dsbr.configuration.title: DSRO Render Optimization
dsbr.configuration.mode.tooltip: GPU includes texture optimization and animated dragon soul batching. TEXTURES only caches textures. VANILLA uses the original renderer. Unsupported paths fall back automatically.
dsbr.configuration.textureBudgetMiB.tool: Soft texture cache budget. Textures used by this frame remain protected.
dsbr.configuration.meshBudgetMiB.tooltip: Budget for meshes, independent animation poses and GPU working buffers.
Unused textures are retained for this duration, subject to the memory budget.
dsbr.configuration.traceDirtyFlags.toolt: Save up to 32 invalidation call stacks. Enable only for troubleshooting.
dsbr.configuration.detailedDiagnostics.t: Record individual players and textures. Enable only for troubleshooting.
dsbr.configuration.beloongNpcGpu.tooltip: GPU mode: accelerate verified Core 0.10.1 NPC geometry. Core is optional; unknown versions use their original renderer.
dsbr.configuration.reuseCpuVertexScratch: GPU mode: reuse temporary matrices and vectors on audited fallback paths, including inventory previews.
